method: Read-only review of the complete runtime diff, new modules, persistence/network/repair callers, new and reused QA, responsive CSS and release workflow according to review-agent. Self-review by the implementation agent, not independent.
resolvedFindings: Move panel controls into a visible grid row at narrow/short viewport sizes; existing mobile CSS hid the specification column.
Continue saved opening/closing poses in the showroom and save the settled angle when leaving the garage.
Close panels through the same damped hinge integration before engaging a healthy latch, instead of snapping the angle to zero.
Keep open-door contact sound separate from warning popups and bound the event queue.
Skip closed-door obstacle queries and retain remote mesh deformation geometry while shape values are unchanged.
visualCheck: Opened Hachi, Atlas, Kitsune and Vector; missing door; portrait and short-landscape controls inspected.
limits: Phase 3 is partial: separate glass/lamps/small appendages and scratches/cracks remain open.
Local rigid proxies with simplified rotation and collision dimensions; no full soft body, no mutual debris collisions, existing loose wheel model retained.
Open doors have an extra obstacle contact; hood/trunk do not have complete 3D collision bodies. Loose debris is local only.
Simple door cards and engine-compartment/block foundation do not complete Phase 4 interiors or Phase 6 animated engine bays.
Local Chromium software rendering and public PeerJS/WebRTC; no physical controller, separate-PC, mobile-network or TURN traversal validation.
CPU sample excludes world, debris queries, GPU, AI and audio; no FPS guarantee.
